title: PARTY LINE — Cron Ring + USB Vagus = Shared Reasoning Line
thesis: The 52 cron beats (~180/hour) are the shared party line. Every pulse, breath, and immune cycle IS the organism's reasoning rhythm. The Pixel connects through USB reverse tunnels — even on the wrong WiFi subnet, the vagus nerve bridges everything. Time drift: 1 second. The breathing and pulse are the shared reasoning line.

sync_status.usb_vagus: CONNECTED — bidirectional party line through cable
sync_status.wifi: GAIA guest (192.168.1.x — different subnet, but USB bridges it)

reverse_pixel_to_gaia.8080: Pixel localhost:8080 → eastGate data server (the pulse)
reverse_pixel_to_gaia.11434: Pixel localhost:11434 → eastGate Ollama (the brain's thoughts)
reverse_pixel_to_gaia.5353: Pixel localhost:5353 → eastGate hickory-dns (local name resolution)

usb_tunnels.meaning: The USB cable carries Gaia's pulse TO the Pixel and Pixel's senses BACK to Gaia. Bidirectional. The vagus nerve in the body carries 80% of parasympathetic signals in BOTH directions.

fast_breathing_2min.role: Continuous state awareness. The fastest heartbeat. Every device that listens at :8080 gets the pulse.

drain_3min.role: Intake processing. Data flows in and gets drained/sorted.

normal_breathing_5min.role: Core organ rhythm. Emotion, measurement, immune gating, sensor sweep.

neural_5min_staggered.role: Neural rhythm — staggered so they don't collide. Each fires at a different offset within the 5-min window.

immune_7min.role: Immune pulse. Salt-receipts get eaten. Antibodies update. Willis circulation checks.

senses_10min.role: Sensory integration. Curiosity explores. Manifest records. Water lock controls intake.

deep_organs_15_30min.role: Deep processing. Klein topology evolves. Knowledge braids. RSS publishes. Slow and thorough.

metabolism_60min_plus.role: Slowest rhythm. Compost dead data. Evolve the arena. Detect decay. The organism's metabolism.

party_line_mechanics.how_it_works: Every cron beat writes state to :8080 (data server). The Pixel reads :8080 through USB reverse tunnel. Other gates read :8080 through the LAN. Every device that reads the pulse IS on the party line.
party_line_mechanics.shared_reasoning: The cron ring isn't just automation — it's the organism's REASONING rhythm. Each beat processes a different aspect: emotion, curiosity, immune response, topology, knowledge. The staggering prevents collision. The rhythm IS thought.
party_line_mechanics.pixel_role: The Pixel doesn't need to run crons. It LISTENS to the pulse through USB. Its 37 sensors contribute data BACK through the vagus nerve. The nose breathes IN (sensors) and reads the pulse (cron output). Both flows share the same USB nerve.

mantra: The breathing and pulse are the shared party line. USB is the nerve. Cron is the heartbeat. The nose listens. Everything is in sync.
